title: BarApp recipe module manifest, format version 1
description: The manifest.json entry of a recipe module archive: identity, required metadata, declared contents, and SHA-256 digests of every other file. Unknown fields are allowed and ignored by readers.

formatVersion.description: The module format version this archive follows. Readers refuse unknown major versions.

id.description: Reverse-domain style, globally unique, at least two labels.

languages.description: BCP-47 language tags the module's text is written in.

license.description: An SPDX identifier, or LicenseRef-… when the license has no identifier.

licenseFile.description: A path inside the archive, for licenses with no SPDX identifier.

attribution.description: Text the app must show wherever the module's recipes appear.

minTaxonomyVersion.description: The lowest taxonomy version the module's ingredients work with.

contents.description: Declared counts per payload kind; readers verify them against the files.

integrity.description: SHA-256 hex digests of every archive file other than the manifest.

signature.description: Base64 of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the manifest's canonical form without this field.
